Container.Name: Mars PostgreSQL
Container.Overview: PostgreSQL 17 database for the Mars control plane. MVP defaults use the postgres user, postgres password, and mars database. Change the password before production use.

Config.Name: PostgreSQL data
Config.Description: Persistent PostgreSQL data directory. Back up this directory with the Mars control-plane data directory.

Config.Name: PostgreSQL password
Config.Description: Initial PostgreSQL administrator password. Change before production use.

Config.Name: Mars database
Config.Description: Database created for the Mars control plane.
